name: Disable ad & telemetry daemons
description: 1.1.0 adds the other two members of the contents-analysis stack (ui-detector, cognition manager) and the .path/.socket activation triggers, so the daemons no longer have a watcher re-arming them. Masks and stops Samsung's ad/telemetry daemons (adagent/pisa, canalysis, slive, contents recognition, context-aware, cis) at every boot.
author: levkropp
